snippet.title: Frog Pond (Prototype) for the Atari 2600
snippet.description:
Frog Pond is just like "Frogs & Flies", but it looks better...well, the animation of the walking is crappy though, as there is none, lol.

Also it features a really pointelss 1 player mode (as you can see) XD There is no timer and the insects don't try to kill you, lmao.
